title: Duskwatch Exchange
kicker: A Sablewood trade point where route knowledge, watches, and liability-backed bargains change hands above or beside the old wood.
hook: A Sablewood trade point where route knowledge, watches, and liability-backed bargains change hands above or beside the old wood.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Duskwatch Exchange is where route knowledge changes hands quietly, because the forest charges more for ignorance.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Everyone wants their business done before dark, so the whole place moves at a hurried, friendly clip until the light goes. Lantern counters glow under low awnings. A raised platform keeps watch on road and sky at once. The yard fills with crates, straps, wax...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place pack beetles, courier birds, dusk moths, tired road ponies No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade, or route interests Food, tools, route signs, local goods, or...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Hot food comes off a smoking griddle fast and cheap, skewers, fried roots, a strong dark stew ladled to anyone with a coin and a hurry. The cider is warm, and the portions get bigger as the light gets lower.
